Hair: multicolor-split-streak, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry; one mismatched earring; a wrapped keepsake cord.
